question: Identify the first 10 words, sorted alphabetically, that are 4 to 5 characters long, start with 'r', and have at least one anagram of the same length, considering case-sensitive letters. Provide the count of such anagrams for each word.
sql:
-- Final query: first 10 words, sorted alphabetically, 4-5 chars, start with 'r', 
-- with at least one anagram of same length, showing count of anagrams
WITH all_words AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT words, 
         STRING_AGG(char_val, '' ORDER BY char_val) AS sorted_chars
  FROM (
    SELECT words, SUBSTR(words, generate_series, 1) AS char_val
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT words FROM word_list WHERE words IS NOT NULL) sub, generate_series(1, LENGTH(words))
  ) sub2
  GROUP BY words
),
with_count AS (
  SELECT words, sorted_chars,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY sorted_chars) AS anagram_count
  FROM all_words
)
SELECT words, anagram_count
FROM with_count
WHERE anagram_count > 1
  AND LENGTH(words) BETWEEN 4 AND 5
  AND LEFT(words, 1) = 'r'
ORDER BY words
LIMIT 10
